about: Screening decisions for leads from search-log.json (28 November 2026). Titles were screened; promising leads were read at abstract or full-text level. Excluded groups are summarised with reasons; included leads are in sources.js.

excluded_groups.group: Engineering and materials research (smart textiles, hydrogels, phase-change fibres, evaporative condensers, PV cooling with clay pots)
excluded_groups.reason: No link to a local practice people use; product development.

excluded_groups.group: Crop and livestock genetics (heat tolerance genes, cattle genomics)
Heat-health epidemiology and forecasting (mortality, heatwave prediction, UHI mapping)
excluded_groups.reason: Context for risk, not about practices.

excluded_groups.group: Studies outside South and Southeast Asia (Kenya, South Africa, Ecuador, Iran, China, USA, Europe)
excluded_groups.reason: Out of region; not used as evidence for regional records. China's Dong stilt houses noted as transferability context only.
Factory engineering, not local practice; covered on /factory-heat/.

excluded_groups.group: Protocols and preprints without findings (Pakistan housing trial protocol; Prayagraj, Khulna and student preprints)
excluded_groups.reason: No findings yet, or preprint text not readable here; leads for refresh.

leads_for_next_edition: Nepal vernacular houses summer and winter (2002)
Vernacular rural walling field measurement (J Building Engineering 2026)
Heat in Pregnancy India findings once published
Local-language searches (Hindi, Bangla, Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Thai)
